entities.name: Aspartokinase-homoserine dehydrogenase
observations: A 768-aa query sequence matched reviewed bifunctional aspartokinase/homoserine dehydrogenases at 42.7–46.5% identity over 98.6–100% query coverage; functional assignment is homology-supported, not a direct assay of this query.
Reference annotations assign aspartate kinase activity: L-aspartate + ATP → 4-phospho-L-aspartate + ADP (EC 2.7.2.4; Rhea RHEA:23776).
Reference annotations assign homoserine dehydrogenase activity: L-homoserine + NAD(P)+ → L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + NAD(P)H + H+ (EC 1.1.1.3); exact cofactor preference for the query is unresolved.
